project.name: osgi/netplan/netplan-port
project.description: The netplan contract — the network blueprint port both worlds depend on. Carries ClusterNetworkBlueprint and its value-type collaborators (Cidr, MacAddress); the netplan-core bundle depends on it to derive and synthesise, the host (and the nix-darwin-home blueprint feed) consumes it. NetplanSynthesisService is CLI-facing, not part of the contract — it stays on the netplan-core impl side. A real OSGi bundle at BUILD time (jar + bnd metadata + per-package @Version), yet at RUNTIME host-loaded and system-exported (bytes loaded by the host classloader, package exported to the OSGi world by the system bundle via system.packages.extra, never installBundle). Versioned independently of the reactor GAV via per-package @Version (starts 1.0.0).
